brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.
requirements.evidence: Built a half-n base at (0,0) with full bases at (0,1) and (-1,1). The spike offer s12 (junction (-1,1),(0,0),(0,1)) and the drawer offer s13 (south cut face of (0,0)) both target the same corner. Applying both together was refused: the drawer returned SPIKE_CLASH ('a spike stands at a corner of this cell the drawer (south half) would fill. Take the spike off first'), and the batch was rolled back. The spike and drawer cannot coexist at the same corner under the configurator's rules. Current build (3 pieces, no spike, no drawer) passes check_build with meshClash 'clear'; only a LOOSE_BODY warning on (0,1) remains.

finish.summary: The brief asks for a drawer and a spike at the same corner of the same cell, touching. The configurator refuses this: a drawer on a half base's cut face fills the corner where the spike stands (SPIKE_CLASH). I did not find a way to satisfy it, so the requirement is unmet. The final build holds three base pieces with no drawer or spike, and it passes the mesh check as clear.
